author: sylntthunder
text:
ShadowPit wrote: As for your long setup, I think you took a very reactive trade or an ill informed one, you haven't given enough consideration to the new information right in-front of you, it just engulfed the last printed H4 demand. Not your A+ setup...Price is telling you a story, use everything it offers you...

Shadow Trader,

You are absolutely right when you say that I didn't give enough consideration to the new information that transpired right in front of me. My limit order was based off of the 4hr ftr zone that printed right before the last ftr and was in place before the engulf of the last FTR occurred. Now in my mind, I was thinking that this was surely a FO to the lower FTR and there was no way I was wrong about this one lol

I've noticed that this is

a common thing that hinders me in my progression, trading what I expect vs what I see. You do an excellent job of balancing your expectations with reality. Another trade that exemplifies the importance of trading what you see vs expectations is the huge short you took on the EURUSD some days ago. You had a limit order that you "expected" to get filled but when the market presented you with the reality that price was breaking down prematurely on the right edge during active market hours, you threw your expectations out the window and traded what you saw!

You continue to show me that trading is a fine balance between your expectations and reality. And your 'trading to the right' sensibility is really turning my paradigms of the market around, thus getting me on the track to consistent profitability day by day. Trading the here and now is something I have generally overlooked in lou of my macro analysis/ expectations...

Also as far as the higher RR of smaller TF trading, I am completely with you on this one also and your results show that you can be just as profitable on smaller TFs with smaller stops as a swing trader (what I consider myself to be) is on LTFs which is something I just didn't think was very plausible beforehand. I just have to build trust in myself on the smaller TFs through my continued forward testing and keep reminding myself that the smaller TRs are just a fractal of the larger ones. Last but not least, your journal has inspired me to create a "Universal Trade Plan" that I will be posting on the website in the next week of so after I get the details and drawings hashed out. It entails most, if not all, of the possible setups one could expect to see and utilize in an uptrend, downtrend, and reversal. It is my way of simplifying this to the point where each trade can fit into a general category and as I develop it, has really helped me concentrate my eye to the hot spots.

Anyway, sorry for the brown nosing and drawn out comments in your personal space, but I just wanted to let you know that your journal clicks with me in a special way and has opened my eyes to some very pivotal principles that I have been neglecting.

Thanks SyT

How are you reading the market? Each print of a new Daily will provide new opportunities to focus our energy on. This is but one snap shot in a forever changing picture.
